question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM **of the given word.

**Grandeur**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3) i.e. "Insignificance".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Grandeur: (भव्यता) **- The quality of being magnificent or splendid or grand.

 
 
• **Example**: The grandeur of the Royal Palace is truly impressive.
 
 
 
• **Insignificance**: **(महत्वहीनता)** - The quality of being too small or unimportant to be worth consideration.
 
 
• **Example**: The issues she raised were of relative insignificance compared to the crisis.
 
 

**Therefore, the correct answer is "Insignificance".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Greatness: (महानता)** - The quality of being great; distinguished or eminent.
 
• **Assignment: (असाइनमेंट)** - A task or piece of work assigned to someone as part of a job or course of study.
 
• **Permission: (अनुमति)** - Consent; authorization
